description: Duplicate, move or delete a slide, import one from another deck, find one by its title, delete its empty placeholders (not a title or one with a fill), or set_layout as PowerPoint's Layout menu. Returns the slide order.

layout.description: set_layout: L2 or its name. import: source copies the source's layout in if missing.

ref.description: duplicate, import: ref name for the copy.

slide.description: The slide, s:256 or $ref (import: in source_doc).

source_doc.description: import: the deck to copy from, d2.

to.description: move, duplicate, import: new position from 1. Default after it; import: last.

name: ppt_manage_slides
